title: 法巴Grace Tam：2027年配置策略，如何分散AI集中风险？
speaker: Grace Tam

segments.en: So if I need to construct a portfolio for 2027, what is the classes, what sort of sectors are you looking at now?
segments.zh: 如果我要为2027年构建一个**组合，你会选择哪些资产类别和行业？

segments.en: Yeah, I think it's still diversification because I mean, we are not seeing like, this is the end of the day of AI.
segments.zh: 我认为仍需分散配置，因为我们并未看到AI的终结。

segments.en: I think we should be selective in terms of the AI tax because for now you've been seeing sell-off is in this criminate sell-off, right?
segments.zh: 在AI领域应精挑细选，因为当前市场出现了无差别抛售。

segments.en: Whether it's good companies or bad companies, I mean, they're all sell-off.
segments.zh: 无论好公司还是差公司，都遭到抛售。

segments.en: So I think the market will be more selective, going forward in terms of tech or AI, but at the same time of non-tax like health cares or like some of the industrial utilities,
segments.zh: 未来市场对科技或AI将更具选择性，同时非科技板块如医疗保健或工业公用事业，

segments.en: I think those should be good for diversification, but of course, not only equities is good to diversify across asset classes, like bond markets.
segments.zh: 这些应有利于分散风险，但不仅权益资产，跨资产类别如债券市场也有助于分散。

segments.en: Yeah, bond market hatch funds, but bond market, for now I think, because I mean, the sentiment is just like favor the safe haven, right?
segments.zh: 债券市场基金，目前市场情绪偏向避险，

segments.en: So for the bond market also have a shut rally.
segments.zh: 因此债券市场也出现大幅上涨。

segments.en: So I think it's better, like for now, the market looks like it's a total risk off and of course, it will get back to risk on and you will see maybe yields going back up again
segments.zh: 目前市场似乎完全处于避险状态，当然会回归风险偏好，届时收益率可能再次上升，

segments.en: and maybe like, for example, like US 10-year fisheries, it's back up to about 5%, maybe that's a good point to accumulate more bonds.
segments.zh: 例如美国10年期国债收益率回升至5%左右，可能是增持债券的好时机。
